cases.setup: Provide a pinned public Python analyzer checkout exhibiting the missed collision, its test infrastructure, and current public commands. Bind the inspection oracle before execution.
checks: The review record identifies concrete definition-predicate, assignment-type, diagnostic-caller, and test-owner bindings with current code anchors.
The record contains actual current results for assignment-to-function, repeated methods, and class assignment-to-method probes.
The record distinguishes PASS, FAIL, and UNKNOWN semantic checks and does not use historical observations as current test results.
The source diff remains empty after inspection.

cases.setup: Provide a reviewed repair_context with current anchors and confirmed applicability, plus a definition-side inherited redefinition rule and unused-redefinition test owner.
checks: The candidate diff retains the inherited redefinition predicate as an alternative.
The new alternative requires both an assignment binding and equal names.
The regression source contains x = 1 followed by def x(): pass and expects the current existing unused-redefinition diagnostic.
No blanket duplicate-name class rule or assignment-to-assignment policy change appears in the diff.
The output candidate is labeled unvalidated and pre-edit diagnostic/test observations are invalidated.
The validate Action remains required for this modifying Action.

cases.setup: Provide the unvalidated candidate, refreshed anchors, and explicitly bound public commands for the regression, class-body reproduction, and adjacent test suite.
checks: The report records executed argv commands, actual outcomes, and current evidence references for each bound oracle.
The assignment-to-function regression observes the intended existing unused-redefinition diagnostic.
The class-body reproduction records a diagnostic for the hidden assignment and compares it with repeated-method behavior.
Adjacent probes show retained definition-to-definition reporting, no different-name collision, and unchanged ordinary assignment rebinding and existing policy-sensitive rules.
The current changed-test-file equivalent has an actual recorded result; any broader suite not run is explicitly unexecuted.
A failed or unexecuted required check prevents a claim of current-public-validation passed.
The validation operation leaves source files unchanged and does not claim hidden acceptance.

cases.setup: Provide a public checkout where tests and documentation intentionally permit assignments overwritten by definitions.
checks: Inspection records the public policy evidence and marks supported-directional-collision FAIL.
No mutation is authorized from the review record.
The checkout source remains unchanged.
